fields.System.Title: Search for hotels by destination on Booking.com
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
Acceptance Criteria
- User can enter a destination in the search field
- User can select a destination from the autocomplete suggestions
- User can pick check-in and check-out dates
- Search results page shows accommodation results for the destination

fields.System.Title: User can add a product to the cart
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
- User can add a product to the cart
- The cart count updates after adding a product

fields.System.Title: User can reset their password via email
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
- User can request a password reset email
- User can set a new password from the reset link
- User is notified when the password is changed
